hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"; if ! command -v mise >/dev/null; then case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) winget install --id jdx.mise --exact --source winget --silent --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$(cygpath -u "$LOCALAPPDATA")/Microsoft/WinGet/Links:$PATH" ;; *) curl -fsSL https://mise.run | MISE_VERSION=v2026.10.15 sh >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; command -v mise >/dev/null || { echo "mise could not be installed: https://mise.jdx.dev/installing-mise.html"; exit 1; }; fi; M="$(command -v mise)"; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; "$M" trust -q . || exit 1; out=$("$M" install 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -20; exit 1; }; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo "eval \"\$('$M' env -s bash -C '$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR')\"" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; "$M" exec -- sh -c 'echo "node $(node --version), pnpm $(pnpm --version), $(vp --version | head -1)"'
